source: Vitals ranges from RustMVP inventory_survival.md §10 (health 100, food 500, water 250). Metabolism, starvation, thirst, cold, regeneration and the respawn vitals from hollow-orbit js/game/player.js. Body-part multipliers from RustMVP damage_rules.hpp (head 2, body 1, limbs 0.5). Corpse and dropped-item lifetimes, the beach respawn without a wait, and the respawn kit (a rock and a torch) are Rust's. Bleeding is ours.

climateStandIn.note: The first world (GROUND.md §3): mean 18 °C, 13-20 °C between night and day; the planet package's climate replaces it.

rateLimits.note: RustMVP command_budget.hpp: 16 at once, 20 a second; every arrival costs one.
